Tutor.description: A tutor or coordinator working for the agency. A first name alone is not an identity.

Learner.description: A pupil the agency tutors, whoever pays for the sessions.

Teaching.description: Which tutor teaches a learner, and in what capacity: the regular tutor, a substitute covering, or the examiner who marks mock papers.

Oversight.description: How one tutor looks after another: a moderator checks their reports, a buddy is a peer they lean on.

Lesson.description: One tutoring session for a learner. booked_by arranged it, taught_by teaches it, observed_by sits in to observe; outcome is planned, held, missed or rescheduled.

Bundle.description: A package of sessions bought for a learner. prepaid stays empty until a prepayment is recorded.

questions.q: Who is Felix Adeyemi's regular tutor?

questions.speaker: ines

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Lesson) WHERE n0.topic = 'titration practice' RETURN n0.minutes AS minutes

questions.speaker: thandi

questions.q: Is there a record of homework for the essay clinic?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Lesson) WHERE n0.topic = 'essay clinic' RETURN coalesce(n0.homework_set, false) AS homework_set
